confirmedBehavior.topic: Provider receipt completeness and failure paths
confirmedBehavior.finding: Each attempted Chat records an attempt before dispatch. The terminal envelope observer records both explicit nonnegative counter presence and observed values before message/tool parsing or consumer cancellation. Missing terminal receipts remain unknown/partial even when prior generations have positive totals; explicit zero differs from absent. Rejected payload, length, duplicate-ID, terminal provider-error and cancellation-after-terminal paths retain terminal receipts once.

Invocation-local ledger replaces usage accumulation from replayable ADK events. Empty retry receipts and summary generations share that ledger. Child invocation receipts are attached to the parent once; workflow checkpoints separately retain prior aggregate receipts and unknown legacy contributions. Controlled cancellation waits for nested callback unwind before final accounting. Focused tests exercise real fake-provider nested calls, summary, retry and workflow resume.

Shared evidence verifier requires unchanged output hashes and matching observed token total/accounting but does not require complete measurements. Truthful rejected reviews of unchanged legacy/partial evidence and idempotent resubmission remain possible. Promote separately recomputes the current paired gate, rejecting legacy/partial/malformed measurement evidence even when saved old eligibility and independent approval say otherwise. Failed trials remain in denominators; invalid comparisons produce no supported ratios.

Only durable oversized command observations receive the bounded fixed-field metadata projection. The returned model content/data map remains unchanged. Exact numeric exitCode and boolean flags are retained from JSON-normalized host results; absent/invalid fields are omitted, never defaulted to success. The verifier uses exitCode default -1 and explicit readOnly argument. Error text and sequence ordering remain outside the projection and unchanged. No stdout/stderr/body is copied into metadata. Change summaries and omitted-field/count flags remain bounded and explicit. Synthetic typed exit0, nonzero and writable observations preserve the intended verification predicate after serialization.

Frontend displays ratios and activation affordance only with explicit complete qualified cost fields and finite positive ratios. Legacy/partial records show uncertainty. New token-accounting events stay in the raw journal while presentation SQL, App activity and execution graph exclude them; pagination test verifies they do not starve visible events.

initialRestrictedAttempt.outcome: Some fixtures could not bind httptest loopback ports under sandbox; failed with operation not permitted. Approved local-listener rerun above passed. Initial evidence preserved; not classified as production failure.

limits: This is source-only verification. The packaged 0.2.0 binary and active 72-trial campaign still use the original frozen build; no fix or passed regression is attributed retroactively to their outcomes.

The frozen campaign positive partial token totals remain observed lower bounds, not complete cost evidence. Independent promotion must not approve unsupported complete-cost claims regardless of any saved old eligible gate.

Complete means every attempted generation has a terminal provider receipt with both explicit nonnegative token counts. It is receipt completeness, not independently measured physical compute, provider counter accuracy, elapsed-cost decomposition or proof that the task succeeded.
Failures before provider dispatch may conservatively leave an unknown attempted-generation contribution; this fails closed rather than guessing zero consumption.
Abrupt interruption and legacy records do not gain inferred accounting. Historical observation metadata lost by the old truncation behavior is not reconstructed.
Metadata verification uses synthetic typed execution results and the actual verifier; this review ran no real process-tree or inference qualification.
No promotion verdict or unfinished campaign outcome is inferred from this source review.
